post.description: Creates a new user account and sends an email confirmation link.

get.description: Validates the confirmation token and marks the user's email as confirmed.

post.description: Resends the email confirmation link. No-op if the email is already confirmed or does not exist.

204.description: Confirmation email sent (or silently skipped if already confirmed)

post.description: Authenticates a confirmed user and returns an access + refresh token pair.
Issues a new access + refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Sends a password reset email. No-op if the email is not registered.

204.description: Reset email sent (or silently skipped if email not found)

post.description: Resets the user password using a valid reset token.
Revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile from the JWT payload.
Returns the caller's channel: nickname, name, description, the last nickname change and when the 14-day nickname cooldown ends (null when a change is allowed now).

patch.description: Partially updates nickname, name and/or description and returns the updated channel (so the client can refresh its channel slug). A new nickname must match ^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$, not be reserved or taken, and can change once every 14 days; submitting the current nickname is a no-op.

400.description: Body fails validation or is empty

409.description: NICKNAME_TAKEN, NICKNAME_RESERVED or NICKNAME_CHANGE_COOLDOWN (changed less than 14 days ago)

get.description: Returns the public information of the channel with this nickname (case-insensitive): nickname, name, description and creation date. Anonymous access.

404.description: CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND — no channel with this nickname

get.summary: Get a public channel page header

post.description: Pre-registers the video as a draft under the caller channel and opens a multipart upload. Bytes are sent directly to storage through presigned part URLs.
Issues presigned UploadPart URLs for the requested part numbers (owner only, while uploading). Can be called again to resume failed parts. `:id` is the video public_id.

403.description: Caller does not own the video

post.description: Completes the multipart upload, verifies the stored size and enqueues background processing (owner only, while uploading). `:id` is the video public_id.

400.description: Validation failed or parts rejected by storage (UPLOAD_PARTS_INVALID)

403.description: Caller does not own the video

get.description: Returns the VideoDetail shape. Published videos (public or unlisted) are readable by anyone with the link; a draft is readable only by its owner. Optional bearer token: when valid it identifies the owner, when missing, invalid or expired the caller is treated as anonymous. `:id` is the video public_id. Carries `view_count` and the owning `channel { nickname, name }`; the frontend compares `channel.nickname` with the session channelSlug to decide whether to show the download button.

404.description: Video not found, or the video is a draft and the caller is not its owner

get.summary: Get a video by its unique URL id

patch.description: Partially updates title, description, category (by slug) and visibility (owner only). At least one field is required; `null` clears description or category. Visibility is independent of publication. `:id` is the video public_id.

400.description: Validation failed or empty body (VALIDATION_ERROR), or unknown category slug (INVALID_CATEGORY)

403.description: Caller does not own the video

409.description: Category cannot be cleared on a published video (PUBLISH_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET)

post.description: Moves the video from draft to published (owner only). Requires processing_status `ready` and a category. `published_at` is set on the first publication and kept on later re-publications. Idempotent: an already published video is returned unchanged. `:id` is the video public_id.

403.description: Caller does not own the video

409.description: Video is not ready (VIDEO_NOT_READY) or has no category (PUBLISH_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET)

post.description: Moves the video back to draft (owner only), keeping `published_at`. Idempotent: a draft is returned unchanged. `:id` is the video public_id.

403.description: Caller does not own the video

put.description: Uploads a custom thumbnail (owner only). The image is re-encoded to a 1280×720 JPEG (scaled and center-cropped, metadata dropped), stored under a new versioned public URL, and the previous thumbnail is deleted. Later processing never overwrites a custom thumbnail. `:id` is the video public_id.

file.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP image, at most 2 MB (2 097 152 bytes)

400.description: File missing, not JPEG/PNG/WebP by content, or undecodable (INVALID_THUMBNAIL)

403.description: Caller does not own the video

get.description: Up to 12 published, public and ready videos for the watch-page sidebar (no pagination): the most viewed of the same category as the current video (most recent first on ties), completed with the most recent videos from other categories. Never includes the current video, drafts or unlisted videos. The current video follows the same read rule as GET /videos/:id. `:id` is the video public_id.

404.description: Video not found, or the video is a draft and the caller is not its owner

get.description: Returns a short-lived presigned URL to the processed faststart MP4; storage serves HTTP Range for seeking. Same read rule as GET /videos/:id: published videos for anyone with the link, drafts owner-only. Optional bearer token identifies the owner. `:id` is the video public_id.

404.description: Video not found, or the video is a draft and the caller is not its owner

get.description: Returns a short-lived presigned URL to the processed MP4 with an attachment Content-Disposition (owner only). The watch page shows the download button only to the channel owner (VideoDetail `channel.nickname` equals the session channelSlug); anyone else gets 401/403. `:id` is the video public_id.

403.description: Caller does not own the video

get.description: Lists every video of the caller's channel — drafts, published, processing and failed — newest first by created_at, with offset pagination (page/per_page) and the total count.

Lists only published, public and ready videos of the channel — drafts and unlisted videos never appear, not even for the owner — newest published_at first, with keyset pagination: pass the previous `next_cursor` as `cursor` (null on the last page).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque value from a previous `next_cursor`; omit for the first page.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR — malformed cursor or invalid limit

404.description: CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND — no channel with this nickname

get.description: Returns the fixed catalog of video categories ordered by name. The slug is the identifier used when editing a video.

post.description: Called by the player when playback starts. Counts at most one view per viewer per dedup window (VIEW_DEDUP_WINDOW_SECONDS, default 24 h): the viewer is the user id when a valid bearer token is sent, otherwise a hash of the client IP (last X-Forwarded-For entry) and User-Agent. Views by the channel owner are never counted. Always 204 — counted, deduplicated or skipped. `:id` is the video public_id.

404.description: Video not found, or the video is a draft and the caller is not its owner

409.description: The video is not ready for playback

next_nickname_change_at.description: When the 14-day nickname cooldown ends; null when a change is allowed now

nickname.description:
New handle; lowercased, `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$`, not reserved, unique.
Can change once every 14 days; sending the current nickname is a no-op.

file_name.description: Original file name of the video being uploaded.

file_size.description: Declared size in bytes; must not exceed MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (10 GiB by default).

content_type.description: Declared MIME type of the video.

part_size.description: Bytes per part (last part may be smaller)

part_numbers.description: Part numbers (1-based) to presign; at most 100 per request.

url.description: Presigned UploadPart URL — PUT the raw part bytes; read the ETag response header

etag.description: ETag returned by storage for this part's PUT.

parts.description: Every uploaded part (exactly part_count items, unique part_number).

nickname.description: Channel handle; the frontend compares it with the session channelSlug to show the download button

thumbnail_url.description: Stable public URL (thumbnails/ prefix), presigned GET for legacy keys, or null

category.description: Category `slug` (see GET /categories); `null` clears it — rejected on a published video.

visibility.description: `public` or `unlisted`; editable at any time, independent of publication.

thumbnail_url.description: Stable public URL of the new 1280×720 JPEG thumbnail
Stable public URL (thumbnails/ prefix), presigned GET for legacy keys, or null

url.description: Short-lived presigned GET URL served by object storage (supports HTTP Range)

thumbnail_url.description: Stable public URL (thumbnails/ prefix), presigned GET for legacy keys, or null

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page

slug.description: Stable category identifier sent when editing a video
